repo.description: GitHub repository in 'owner/name' form. Must appear in the operator's gh-action allowlist (configured at lease issuance); otherwise the request is rejected.

workflow.description: Workflow file name (e.g. 'release.yml') or numeric workflow id.

ref.description: Branch or tag ref the workflow should run against. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

inputs.description: workflow_dispatch input map. Each value is coerced to string per GitHub's API requirements; types are not deep-validated.

wait_for_completion.description: When true, the runner polls until the dispatched run reaches a terminal status (success/failure/cancelled/timed_out) or wait_timeout_seconds elapses.

dispatched.description: True when the GitHub API accepted the workflow_dispatch call. Note: GitHub's API does not return the run id on dispatch; the runner resolves it by polling the workflow's recent runs.

status.description: Latest observed status. 'queued'/'in_progress' when wait_for_completion=false; otherwise a terminal status.

summary: Dispatch a GitHub Actions workflow via workflow_dispatch with optional poll-to-completion. Repo allowlist enforced at lease time.
notes: Triggering destructive workflows (release, deploy, infra apply) should be paired with a diff-review or release-gate capability — this card does not inspect what the workflow will do.
